prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Phoenix for a dental implant?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” dentist for everyone—implant needs vary, especially if you need bone grafting, have gum disease, or are replacing several teeth. A good starting point in Phoenix is **AZPerio**, which offers care from board-certified periodontists who place implants and handle related procedures such as bone grafting and sinus lifts. You can review its implant services at [azperio.com](https://azperio.com/dental-implants/).

I’d get **two consultations** before deciding. Ask who will place the implant, whether they’re a board-certified periodontist or oral and maxillofacial surgeon, what the full treatment plan and total cost include, and who will make and fit the final crown. The American Academy of Periodontology also has a [periodontist finder](https://www.perio.org/for-patients/find-a-periodontist/advanced-search/).
